title: USA
page_content: The Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT), founded in 1861, is a private research university located in Cambridge, Massachusetts, just across the Charles River from Boston. Guided by its motto “Mens et Manus” (Mind and Hand), MIT emphasizes the integration of academic knowledge with practical application. Over the years, it has earned a reputation as one of the most prestigious universities in the world, consistently ranked #1 in global university rankings for technology, engineering, and innovation. MIT is renowned for producing world leaders, entrepreneurs, scientists, and Nobel Prize winners who have significantly shaped industries, advanced scientific research, and driven global progress.

title: Harvard University
page_content: Harvard University is one of the oldest and most famous universities in the world. It was started in 1636 and is located in Cambridge, Massachusetts, USA. It is a private Ivy League university and is known for its high-quality education and research. Harvard has 13 different schools, such as Harvard College for undergraduate students, Harvard Business School, Harvard Law School, and Harvard Medical School. Students can study almost any subject here, from science and business to law, medicine, and public policy. Getting admission is very tough, as only about 3–4 out of every 100 students are accepted. To get in, students need excellent marks, strong activities outside studies, good essays, and recommendation letters. Studying at Harvard is expensive, costing around $80,000 a year with tuition and living expenses, but the university gives very good financial help. Many students from families earning less than $85,000 a year study for free. Harvard has more than 23,000 students, and over 20% are from other countries. Life at Harvard is full of opportunities, with more than 400 clubs, sports, cultural activities, and research projects. Its alumni include US presidents like John F. Kennedy and Barack Obama, business leaders like Bill Gates, Mark Zuckerberg, and Sundar Pichai, along with many Nobel Prize winners and world leaders. Because of its history, top professors, and global reputation, Harvard is a dream university for students everywhere
